name: orchestrator
description: Event-driven orchestration engine: subscribes to platform EventBridge events and dispatches actions (email, and later SMS/voice/agentic) based on workflow definitions stored in the Core API. Durable state lives in Core (ADR-0002); this plugin runs its own Lambda and reaches Core over the IAM-authenticated internal API (ADR-0009).
author: Biffo Team

event_subscriptions.description: Catch-all: the engine is a generic forwarder — it reacts to every event and posts it to the Core internal API, which matches enabled workflow definitions (by source + detail_type) and decides what to run. Wired via the SDK's subscribe_all() (see src/orchestrator/plugin.py) and a broad EventBridge rule (terraform/); adding a new trigger needs no plugin change (ADR-0010, epic #210).
